kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx3 update-workflow --cluster-id xxljob-d6a5243b6fa --app-name test-app --workflow-id 1 --name myWorkflow --description my_first_workflow --time-type 1 --time-expression 0_0/10_0_0_0_0 --timezone GMT+8 --calendar workday --max-concurrency 1 --client-token D0DE9C33-992A-580B-89C4-B609A292748D --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateWorkflow

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling type. Valid values:

`-1` (none): The workflow is not scheduled and must be triggered on demand.

`1` (cron): The workflow runs based on the cron expression in the `TimeExpression` parameter.

`100` (api): The workflow is triggered by an API call
parameters.help_zh:
调度类型，目前支持以下几种类型：
-1: none
1：cron
100:：api
parameters.name: time_type

parameters.help_en:
The cron expression for the schedule. This parameter is required only when `TimeType` is set to `1` (cron).

If `TimeType` is `-1` (none), this parameter is not required.

If `TimeType` is `1` (cron), specify a standard cron expression.

If `TimeType` is `100` (api), this parameter is not required
parameters.help_zh:
时间表达式，根据选择的时间类型设置时间表达式。
none：无需填写
cron：填写标准的cron表达式，支持在线验证。
api：无需填写
parameters.name: time_expression

parameters.help_en:
The time zone for the schedule.

Defaults to the time zone of the SchedulerX server
parameters.help_zh:
时区
默认使用schedulerx服务器所在时区
parameters.name: timezone

parameters.help_en: The name of a custom calendar to exclude specific dates from the schedule
parameters.name: calendar

parameters.help_en:
The maximum concurrency for the workflow.

The maximum number of concurrent instances that can run for the same workflow. A value of `1` prevents overlapping runs. If the number of running instances reaches this limit, subsequent scheduled runs are skipped
parameters.help_zh:
最大并发数
同一个工作流同一时间允许运行的最大实例个数，1表示不允许重复执行。如果超过并发数，会跳过当前调度
parameters.name: max_concurrency

parameters.help_en: A unique token that you provide to ensure the request is idempotent. The token can be up to 64 ASCII characters long
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
